title: Network Activity Terms for Domestic Main Cabin Awards under Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements
content:
**Terms.** For a domestic Crestline Main Cabin round-trip award redeemed from Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements company points, the flown coupons on the company's tickets, placed by flight date, in the award coupon window of 12 calendar months up to and including the redemption date set the award coupon percentage. The flown coupons are those in the fare ledger of the company's tickets under Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.

| Flown coupons in the 12-month window | Award coupon percentage |
|---|---|
| 30 or more | 92 percent |
| 15 or more, and fewer than 30 | 96 percent |
| fewer than 15 | 100 percent (the listed price) |

**How the percentage acts.** The award coupon percentage multiplies the standard domestic award price, the tier's domestic Main Cabin round-trip award points. Where the price carries several such percentages, they are all applied together to the standard price, each divided by one hundred, and the product is rounded to the nearest whole point once.

### Cases (hypothetical)

| Flown coupons | Percentage |
|---|---|
| 14 | 100 |
| 15 | 96 |
| 29 | 96 |
| 30 | 92 |

A company with 32 flown coupons in the window, with no other percentage on the price, redeems a 1600-point standard price at 1600 multiplied by 92 and divided by one hundred: 1472 points.
